description: Find a bus to convert into a skoolie (a school bus or shuttle turned into a camper or tiny home). Returns used school, activity, shuttle and cutaway buses listed by dealers here, live federal surplus auction lots, and ready-made searches on GovDeals, Public Surplus and Municibid filtered by distance and price, and category links into Skoolie Livin' Classifieds. Auction and classified results are links to those sites, not copies of their listings. Free, no account.

radius_miles.description: How far the buyer will travel. Default 250.

state.description: Two-letter US state, used for dealer listings and federal lots, e.g. FL.

zip.description: US ZIP code to search around, e.g. 32801.

name: find_skoolie_bus
